context: Two teens debrief after a tense social media incident
purpose: Teach: 外見/プライド/資質/モラル/狩り/シンボル/青空/マスク

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 見た？さっきの投稿、めっちゃ拡散されてるんだけど。外見だけで判断してくる人ばっかでさ、もう最悪。
lines.en: Did you see it? That post is spreading like crazy. Everyone's judging me just by looks — it's the worst.
lines.style: Frustrated teen venting, casual rapid-fire speech, exasperated tone

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 見た見た。あれはひどいって。匿名で叩いてくる連中、完全にモラルの問題だよね。人としてどうかと思う。
lines.en: Yeah I saw it. That was rough. The anonymous people piling on — it's totally a moral issue. Makes you question them as humans.
lines.style: Supportive friend, indignant but level-headed, slightly older-brother tone

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: しかもさ、ネットだと一人を皆で追い詰めるじゃん？あれもう狩りみたいなもんだよ。怖すぎる。
lines.en: And online, everyone corners one person together, right? It's basically a hunt at that point. Way too scary.
lines.style: Anxious confession, voice dropping lower, genuine fear underneath sarcasm

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: わかる。あの匿名アイコンがもう嫌がらせのシンボルになってるよな。見るたび鳥肌立つわ。
lines.en: I get it. That anonymous icon has basically become the symbol of harassment now. Gives me chills every time I see it.
lines.style: Empathetic agreement, jaded observation, slightly philosophical for a teen

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 正直、プライド傷つけられるのが一番きつい。私の何を知ってるんだよって感じ。
lines.en: Honestly, having my pride hurt is what stings the most. Like, what do they even know about me?
lines.style: Vulnerable admission, voice cracking slightly, defensive anger

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 桜は強いから大丈夫。そういう逆境で折れない資質があるってこと、俺は知ってるし。
lines.en: Sakura, you're strong, you'll be fine. I know you've got the kind of character that doesn't break under stuff like this.
lines.style: Sincere reassurance, dropping the joking tone completely, quiet confidence

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: …ありがと。明日マスクして学校行くつもりだったけど、やめとくわ。隠れたら負けな気がして。
lines.en: ...Thanks. I was gonna wear a mask to school tomorrow, but I'll skip it. Feels like hiding means losing.
lines.style: Soft pause, gathering resolve, voice steadier toward the end

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: それでいい。明日は青空らしいぞ。下向いて歩くな、堂々と行こうぜ。
lines.en: That's the spirit. Tomorrow's supposed to be clear blue skies. Don't look down — walk in there with your head up.
lines.style: Warm encouragement, casual masculine cheer-up, hopeful closing note
